test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

I am often invited by them to join their club.

options.text: I often invite them to join the club.
The club often invites me to join them.
They often invite me to join their club.
They have often invited me to join their club

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

__
 
• In the given sentence is in** passive form and** it has been changed into active voice. 

 
 
• **Object Pronoun 'them'** is changed into **subject pronoun 'they'.**
 
• Passive verb is changed into active verb and it is in simple present tense as the question is in the same tense.
 
 
 
• The verb "**invite"** is used in its base form** (V1)** and according to the subject **"they" **(3rd person plural form )
 
• The subject pronoun** 'I' **is changed into object pronoun **'me'.**
 
• The phrase **"to join their club" **is retained in the active form without any change.

Hence the correct statement is '**They often invite me to join their club.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In passive voice, the subject of the sentence **receives **the action, while in active voice, the subject **performs** the action.
 
• Passive: "I am often invited by them to join their club."
 
 
• Subject: I
 
• Verb: am invited
 
• Agent: by them
 
• Action: to join their club
 
 
 
• Active: "They often invite me to join their club."
 
 
• Subject: They
 
• Verb: invite
 
• Object: me
 
• Action: to join their club
